name: Legion
oneLiner: AI-native workforce management platform for hourly teams that forecasts demand, auto-builds compliant schedules and handles time, attendance and employee communication.
bestFor: Large multi-unit operators (retail, convenience, quick-service and fast casual) with big hourly workforces and predictive-scheduling rules to comply with.

updates.text: Released more than 90 new features, including a new generation of AI assistants aimed at automating scheduling decisions.
Spring 2026 release made generally available, adding an AI Upper Field Schedule Assistant for district and area managers alongside existing schedule, forecast and shift assistants.
Published a Forrester Total Economic Impact study of Legion WFM (commissioned by Legion, based on four retail and hospitality customers).

features: AI demand forecasting from sales and traffic data
Automatic schedule generation within labor budgets
Fair Workweek and predictive-scheduling compliance tracking, including premium pay
Employee mobile app for shift swaps, open shifts and availability
AI assistants that build, explain and translate schedules
Multi-store views for district and area managers
notes: No named restaurant customer found; Legion's restaurant case study is an unnamed Chicago-rooted fast-casual chain. 2026 customer announcements are Wilson James (UK security/facilities services) and Wolt (delivery platform, Feb 2026, 20 EMEA countries; no primary URL captured). Dropped from current review: Blink Fitness, SoulCycle and Suitsupply as customers (not re-confirmed), '7-8 hours a week saved' and '96% of the time' claims (vendor stats), and '1,000+ employees' minimum (not confirmed). Forrester '1,340% ROI' is vendor-commissioned, not used. Fit: Legion's 2026 marketing leans heavily toward retail; still offers a restaurant WFM product.
